front_yard_card_reader.title: 刷卡机
front_yard_card_reader.speaker: protagonist
front_yard_card_reader.text: 待做·小门里面的刷卡机，红灯亮着，没有人刷卡

front_yard_gate.title: 伸缩门
front_yard_gate.speaker: protagonist
front_yard_gate.text: 待做·校门的伸缩门关着，像停车场门口那种，机头靠在小门那边

front_yard_dead_tree.title: 枯树
front_yard_dead_tree.speaker: protagonist
front_yard_dead_tree.text: 待做·一棵枯树，一片叶子也没有
